''With apologies to [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fPO76Jlnz6c Coolio] and [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lOfZLb33uCg Weird Al], I present ''Shepherd's Paradise'' as written by [[Rand al'Thor]].''

As I look through the valley of [[Tarwin's Gap]]<br />
[[Eye of the World|Eye]] spy the [[Shadow]] force and see a horde of saps<br />
And that's just perfect for a [[Dragon]] like me<br />
You know, I kill [[Shadowspawn]] with much alacrity

At four thirty in the morning, I'm shearing sheep<br />
Papa [[Tam al'Thor|Tam]] mends the fences and [[Bela]] plows... fool<br />
And I've been shearin' and plowin' so long that<br />
Pretty [[Egwene al'Vere]] thinks my mind is wool

[[Perrin Aybara|Perrin's]] a man of the land, he's into discipline<br />
Got a [[Faile Bashere|Faile]] on his lap and a beard on his chin<br />
But if we finish all of our chores and you finish thine<br />
Then tonight we're gonna party like it's flaming [[Bel Tine]]
